verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs confirm first-party Next.js support and JWT-based short-lived session tokens for backend/API authentication (clerk-docs-19, clerk-docs-6/22/32), and community feedback praises the Next.js integration story (clerk-comm-11), supporting the framework-SDK claim. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents the clerkMiddleware()/edge-runtime session verification mechanism or peer-framework (Remix, SvelteKit, etc.) middleware parity. Missing for 10: explicit middleware API docs, edge-runtime verification details, and coverage of non-Next.js framework middleware equivalents.
